title: psychotria triflora
intro: Psychotria triflora, commonly known as Yellow Shirker, is a flowering plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the Pacific Islands, to treat a range of health issues. The health benefits of Psychotria triflora include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, such as caffeic acid, ferulic acid, and kaempferol.
